news.text: Captain Virgil van Dijk withdrew on 9 November as not fit enough for international football. No replacement was called up.
Striker Brian Brobbey also withdrew for fitness reasons.
Ryan Gravenberch, Nathan Aké, Jeremie Frimpong and Jorrel Hato are injured, and Kenneth Taylor was dropped.
Frenkie de Jong is back for the first time since his World Cup knee injury and is expected to captain the side without Van Dijk.
Donyell Malen is back from a minor knee problem and expected to lead the line, with Mexx Meerdink the alternative. Justin Kluivert and Ian Maatsen are also recalled.
Reports conflict on whether Sepp van den Berg was added as cover. Goal and RotoWire say no replacements were named, leaving Xavi with 23 players.
Christos Zafeiris and Manolis Saliakas are suspended after second bookings against Germany.
Dimitris Kourbelis has an ankle sprain and trained separately on Tuesday. Nektarios Triantis or Thanasis Androutsos would replace him.
Christos Tzolis is in the squad, but his fitness is an open call after a muscle problem picked up in the 1 October draw.
Giannis Michailidis, Dimitrios Pelkas and Giannis Konstantelias are injured.
Tasos Bakasetas is recalled after missing the first four group games.

lineups.alt: Serbia miss Lukić and N. Maksimović (suspended) plus Vlahović, S. Pavlović, Kostić, Stanković and Terzić; Forza and statz.ai expect a back four with Jović up front. Sports Mole gives no first name for Gudelj (Nemanja, the Nations League regular, assumed). For Germany, Bischof and Scherhant are the main alternatives to Nmecha and El Mala.

news.text: Saša Lukić and Nemanja Maksimović are suspended after yellow-card accumulation.
Dušan Vlahović pulled out for private reasons, Paunović said.
Strahinja Pavlović misses out after a blow to the kidney; Milan Krpić was called up.
Filip Kostić withdrew with a leg haematoma (Stefan Bukinac called up) and Aleksandar Stanković left camp with an adductor strain.
Aleksa Terzić is out with an infection.
Aleksandar Mitrović returns from injury but is short of match fitness; Nikola Milenković is also back.
Coach Veljko Paunović serves a touchline ban; assistant Quinton Fortune is expected to take charge.
UEFA crowd sanction: only children and about 2,000 German fans may attend.
Jamal Musiala and Serge Gnabry are injured; Waldemar Anton withdrew injured and Ridle Baku was called up.
Niclas Füllkrug is recalled and Wael Mohya (17) gets a first call-up; Raum, Woltemade and Adeyemi are left out.
Ter Stegen is confirmed as No. 1; Treu, Thiaw and Bisseck are one booking away from a ban.

lineups.alt: Sports Mole and statz.ai still list Luis Binks or Nathan Patterson at the back, but Binks has withdrawn; Ryan Christie and Ché Adams are bench options. Sports Mole's North Macedonia XI has Anes Meljichi, Dimitar Mitrovski and Ljupcho Doriev instead of Serafimov, Nikolov and Churlinov.

news.text: Scott McTominay returns after missing the first four Nations League games following a minor heart procedure; Kieran Tierney and Ché Adams are back from injury.
Scott McKenna (back) and Kenny McLean (ankle) are out. Centre-backs Stephen Welsh (ligament damage) and Luis Binks have withdrawn; Ryan Porteous and David Bates were called up.
Lennon Miller, Josh Doig, Colby Donovan and James Wilson were left out; Rangers' James Penrice gets a first call-up.
Andy Robertson can pass Kenny Dalglish as Scotland's most-capped player if he plays both games this window.
Bojan Miovski is left out by coach Goce Sedloski for lack of minutes at Rangers; Gjoko Zajkov, Andrej Stojchevski and Tihomir Kostadinov are also not in the squad.
Darko Churlinov returns after missing four games over a visa issue; Nikola Serafimov (injury), Boban Nikolov, Imran Fetai and Stefan Despotovski are recalled.
Captain Enis Bardhi and Eljif Elmas are fit; North Macedonia have lost all four group games without scoring (0-10).

news.text: Erik Janža and David Zec are suspended after picking up their second bookings of the campaign in the 2-1 win in Glasgow.
Benjamin Šeško (shin) misses another window and is not expected back until early 2027.
Timi Max Elšnik was injured playing for Crvena zvezda and misses out. Cesar has not called up a replacement.
Atalanta defender Relja Obrić, 20, has his first senior call-up.
Captain Granit Xhaka is out with a calf injury he picked up against Sunderland.
Miro Muheim has left camp with a muscle problem.
Ruben Vargas joined the squad late after a stomach illness.
Breel Embolo is back after missing the September and October games, and blue News expects him to start.
Zeki Amdouni is fit again after an ankle injury.
365Scores lists Ricardo Rodríguez among the absentees, but Sports Mole has him in its predicted XI.
Isaac Schmidt and the uncapped Roggerio Nyakossi were called up as replacements. Michel Aebischer is one booking away from a ban.
